name: Improving sgrep local semantic search quality

description: Baseline: added quality benchmark harness for search MRR on the sgrep repo; benchmark scored 56.00 but cargo test failed during checks (needs triage before keeping any code changes).
Establish first checks-passing baseline for the new search-quality benchmark harness (quality_mrr 55.33; prior 56.00 run had failed checks and was not a valid baseline).

name: Improving sgrep local semantic search quality (corrected benchmark scope)

description: Gated PRF off for precise identifier/path-like queries to reduce query drift. Quality improved to 72.50, but checks failed quickly afterward (likely fmt/clippy), so fix and rerun.
Gate pseudo-relevance feedback off for precise identifier/path-like queries to reduce query drift on targeted code-search questions.

Added query-intent-aware file-type prioritization only (no score-mix changes): code-seeking queries penalize tests/docs more, docs-seeking queries boost documentation. Quality improved to 75.33 but checks failed quickly afterward (likely fmt), so fix and rerun.

Filtered generic action words out of BM25/BM25F query tokenization so lexical scoring focuses on informative terms. Quality improved to 76.00, but checks failed quickly afterward (likely fmt), so fix and rerun.
Filter generic action words out of BM25/BM25F query tokenization so lexical ranking focuses on informative query terms.

Broaden PRF gating so specific locator-style queries (where is/where are/which file/document with a small keyword set) skip query expansion and avoid drift. Quality improved to 77.33, but checks failed quickly afterward (likely fmt), so fix and rerun.
Broaden PRF gating so specific locator-style queries (where is/where are/which file/document with a small keyword set) skip query expansion and avoid drift.
Resume baseline rerun on the current best commit to confirm stability; quality_mrr matched 79.33 exactly, so discard as unchanged.

Replaced hardcoded string-based query heuristics with candidate-driven file-type intent inference and generic PRF gating. Metric held at 79.33 before checks, but quick post-run check failure needs cleanup.

Replace hardcoded string-based search intent heuristics with candidate-driven file-type intent inference and generic PRF gating based on query structure plus ranking confidence; primary metric held at 79.33 while making behavior less benchmark-brittle and more repo-agnostic.
Tried a small generic path-term overlap bonus using informative query terms against filename/parent-dir tokens. It hurt docs and overall ranking (quality_mrr 75.83), so discard.
Tried adding a file-evidence bonus from the second-best chunk in the same file so multi-section modules could outrank one-off hits. It regressed to 75.83 and hurt docs, so discard.

Tried attaching leading adjacent comment blocks to semantic chunks so module docs and API comments participate in retrieval. It improved some config-style queries but regressed overall to 77.17, so discard.

Tried query-adaptive fusion weights that gave more BM25 weight to compact precise-looking queries using structural signals (uppercase/digits/markers). It over-shifted toward lexical matches, perfecting docs but hurting code retrieval and overall MRR, so discard.

Raised BM25F symbol-field term frequency boost from 2 to 3 so identifier/symbol matches carry more lexical weight. Primary metric stayed flat at 79.33 with no broad quality gain, so discard as unchanged.

Tried expanding BM25 tokenization to emit identifier subwords from snake_case and CamelCase so code symbols are matchable by component terms. It improved some exact code-term ranking but regressed docs and latency badly overall, so discard.

Tried a larger internal rerank window (up to 3x the output limit, capped at 50) so PRF, file-type priority, and ANN shortlists operate on more candidates before truncation. Primary quality stayed flat at 79.33 while median latency worsened, so discard.
